text: The plugin id and project key are native-pdf-handwriting; the display name is Handwriting Natively; manifest and package version are 0.1.58.

Sidecar JSON is documented as canonical editable annotation data, recovery is separate, explicit page-structure actions atomically rewrite the open PDF and remap those stores, Export PDF writes a separate annotated copy, and supported image export writes a separate flattened PNG/JPEG copy without changing the source image.
